items.title: Toddler Korean Shrimp Pancake or Jeon (새우전)
items.summary: My toddler LOVES foods she can hold herself right now — and if she can “dip dip” it into a sauce like ketchup, even better These little shrimp jeon are soft, easy to hold, and packed with shrimp + veggies!
items.caption:
🍤 Toddler Korean Shrimp Pancake or Jeon (새우전)

My toddler LOVES foods she can hold herself right now — and if she can “dip dip” it into a sauce like ketchup, even better 😂 These little shrimp jeon are soft, easy to hold, and packed with shrimp + veggies!

Ingredients:
• 9 shrimp — I used @costco Argentine wild-caught shrimp
• Finely chopped onion
• Finely chopped zucchini
• Finely chopped carrot
• 1 egg
• Garlic powder
• 1–2 tbsp cornstarch or potato starch, as needed
• Olive oil for cooking

Directions:

1. Finely mince the raw shrimp into very small pieces.
2. Finely chop the onion, zucchini, and carrot.
3. Add the shrimp and veggies to a bowl with the egg, a sprinkle of garlic powder, and enough cornstarch or potato starch to help everything hold together.
4. Mix until well combined.
5. Heat a little olive oil in a pan over low-medium heat.
6. Spoon small portions into the pan and gently flatten into toddler-sized pancakes.
7. Cook on both sides until golden brown and the shrimp is fully cooked through.
8. Let cool and serve! We added ketchup for dipping because apparently everything tastes better when you can dip it. 😂

items.title: Shrimp Tomato Cream Udon
items.summary: Japanese moms have a super easy way to make “Baby Udon”!
items.caption:
🍅🦐 Japanese moms have a super easy way to make “Baby Udon”!

Just dump everything into the rice cooker → cook for 15 minutes → done. 🙌🍜

🍜 Shrimp Tomato Cream Udon

Ingredients

* Frozen udon — 2 portions
* Frozen shrimp — as much as you like
* Frozen broccoli — as much as you like
* Tomato paste — 2 tbsp
* Milk — 200ml
* Boiled spinach — as much as you like, optional

How to make

1. Add the frozen udon, shrimp, frozen broccoli, and tomato paste to your rice cooker.
2. Pour in the milk and mix lightly.
3. Cook for 15 minutes, then stop the cooking cycle.
4. Stir well and check that the shrimp is fully cooked.
5. Add boiled spinach to taste and mix well.
6. Cut the udon and shrimp into an appropriate size and texture for your baby.

That’s it! 🤯
One pot, almost no prep, and a creamy tomato sauce babies can enjoy. 🍅💛

💾 Save this for your next busy day!
